title: Tip of the Week: Branding Your Compliance Training
titleTag: Tip of the Week:  Branding Your Compliance Training
description: Wouldn't you agree that adding your company logo to your HCP training is a great idea? We want your HCP compliance program to be as unique to your practice as possible. With that in mind, we encourage you to feature your logo on your training page.
body:
Wouldn't you agree that adding your company logo to your HCP training is a great idea?

We want your HCP compliance program to be as unique to your practice as possible. With that in mind, we encourage you to feature your logo on your training page.

If you currently see Healthcare Compliance Pros' Logo in the top left hand corner of your HCP site, you have not yet sent your logo to us.

We'd love to add your logo! As your training represents your policies and procedures, we believe it should be branded with your company logo. This serves as a great reminder that the training you are taking has been customized for your organization and represents your organization's policies and procedures.

You can send your logo to us in jpeg format. Send it as an attachment to an email addressed to [email protected]

If you have any questions about this or any other website related issue , please reach out to us for additional support and training.
